channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: 23 Indians rescued after Ukrainian drone strike sets oil tanker ablaze off Russia’s Black Sea | What we know
item.description: 23 Indian crew members were rescued after a Ukrainian drone strike set an oil tanker on fire off Russia’s Black Sea coast. The attack near Sochi left one Indian crew member injured and came a day after another vessel sank off Romania, killing two.

item.title: CEC Gyanesh Kumar and 2006 Keralam bribery case: What happened then, why is probe being reopened – Explained
item.description: In 2006, Gyanesh Kumar &nbsp;served as Secretary of the state PWD. During his tenure, a bribery claim had emerged after a suicide note of a Malaysian engineer, who was part of a World Bank-aided Road work project executed by a Malaysian and Indian joint venture called PATI-BEL.

item.title: New GRAP Rules in Delhi; Restrictions in NCR Oct 2026: These 8 states; older buses to be impacted - Imp for commuters
item.description: The Commission for Air Quality Management has revised Delhi-NCR's GRAP, bringing restrictions on certain inter-city buses and diesel generator sets into force earlier. The changes also affect goods vehicles, construction sites and commuters across eight states.

item.title: Your gender dictates your path to work: men use two-wheelers, women walk or take a bus
item.description: India’s first National Household Travel Survey reveals a sharp mobility divide: while men rely on two-wheelers, working women walk or take public transit, signalling constrains of regional infrastructure and safety-driven curfews.&nbsp;

item.title: PM Modi offers prayers at Delhi temple, renews service pledge after 25 years as head of govt | Watch
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi marked 25 years as head of government by offering prayers at Delhi’s Shri Vinayaka Temple and renewing his commitment to public service. He began as Gujarat CM in 2001 before becoming PM in 2014.

item.title: FlyDubai co-pilot accused in Israel-bound flight attack trained in UK, New Zealand: What we know
item.description: FlyDubai co-pilot Hamam al-Hammami, accused of attacking the captain of an Israel-bound flight, trained in the UK and New Zealand before joining the airline, according to the Telegraph.&nbsp;

item.title: Former US Army Major Nidal Hasan to be executed by firing squad, making it first military execution in 60 years: Details
item.description: The Pentagon on Monday announced that Nidal Hasan, a former Army major, will be executed by firing squad in December at Fort Hood, Texas, for killing 13 soldiers in 2009, making it the first military execution in over six decades.

item.title: FIR against Rahul, Priyanka Gandhi for entering Akashvani Bhawan during opposition protest
item.description: Citing the need to maintain law and order and prevent the situation from escalating, Delhi Police said it removed the leaders from the complex because they had staged a sit-in and entered the premises without permission.

item.title: ‘Cannot compare’: French envoy on why IMEC’s financing model is ‘very different’ from China’s BRI | Exclusive
item.description: French envoy Gérard Mestrallet said IMEC’s financing model cannot be compared with China’s BRI, as the two projects follow fundamentally different approaches. He said Gaza, Iran and Hormuz risks have made IMEC more necessary as a resilient network of alternative trade routes.

item.title: Priyanka Gandhi climbs gate to reach Rahul Gandhi amid CEC Gyanesh Kumar protest; internet reacts | Watch
item.description: A video of Congress leader Priyanka Gandhi Vadra climbing a gate at Delhi's Kingsway Camp has drawn reactions online, including comments praising her fitness. The incident comes amid opposition protests demanding CEC Gyanesh Kumar's resignation and challenging the revision of electoral rolls.

item.title: Saurav Das to notify Delhi Police of CJP's Oct 10 protest against Gynaesh Kumar — Check 3 key demands
item.description: CJP has announced a fresh agitation at Jantar Mantar from October 10 to press for the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, who is under fire over the SIR exercise and functioning of the poll body.

item.title: Taiwan says US' commitment for island unchanged as Trump yet to approve $14 bn arms sale package amid truce with China
item.description: Taiwan says US defence support remains unchanged, but a proposed $14 billion arms package awaits Trump’s approval. Washington has reaffirmed its commitment, while Trump has delayed the sale as he seeks closer ties and preserves a trade truce with China.

item.title: China Breaks Silence on Plague, Says It’s in Contact With Russia
item.description: Beijing made its first official comments on the suspected case of pneumonic plague in Siberia, saying it’s cooperating with Russia as health concerns intensify around the world.

item.title: Christa Pike is conscious and speaking after Tennessee failed execution | All you need to know about her recovery
item.description: Christa Pike is conscious and speaking six days after Tennessee's failed lethal injection attempt. Her recovery, the circumstances of the execution and the legal questions surrounding a possible second attempt remain uncertain.

item.title: Siberia plague scare: Trump to speak with Putin as Moscow downplays fears; Kremlin asks Russians to ignore rumours
item.description: Trump plans to speak with Putin after a researcher’s death sparked a plague scare in Siberia. Russia has downplayed fears, while the US has sought more information. WHO says the possible pneumonic plague case poses a “very low” risk outside Russia.

item.title: CEC Gyanesh Kumar postpones two-day Chhattisgarh visit amid Opposition protest seeking his removal
item.description: Gyanesh Kumar, who is facing criticism over the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls, was scheduled to visit the Danteshwari Mata temple in Dantewada district, the Chitrakoot waterfall in Bastar, and the Bhoramdev temple in Kawardha district on 7 and 8 October.

item.title: Lionel Messi bids farewell to Argentina national football team: A look at his $1.1 billion net worth, endorsements
item.description: Forbes estimates Messi’s net worth at around $1.1 billion. Over the last 12 months alone, his annual earnings hit $140 million, split evenly between his on-field salary and off-field commercial activities.

item.title: Petrol and diesel prices today, October 7: How much does fuel cost in Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru
item.description: Iran has increased the pace of attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz in recent days, just as oil shipments through the world’s most important energy chokepoint approach prewar levels.

item.title: US Forces in Okinawa to Pause Operations After Arrest of Marine
item.description: The US Forces in Japan will pause operations for 48 hours starting noon on Wednesday and impose a month-long curfew on military personnel, following the arrest of a US Marine on suspicion of murdering a Japanese woman.

item.title: Iran war news LIVE: Tehran ramps up ship attacks in Hormuz days after oil shipments touched pre-war levels
item.description: Iran war news LIVE: Iran has increased the pace of attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz in recent days, just as oil shipments through the world’s most important energy chokepoint approach prewar levels. UK Maritime Trade Operations have reported nine attacks in the waterway already this month.

item.title: US tariffs, missing cells, evening power gaps: inside India’s solar energy bottlenecks
item.description: India’s solar capacity has boomed in the past decade. Now, the way ahead lies upstream: capital-heavy steps to boost cells, wafers and storage.&nbsp;

item.title: Energy shocks should accelerate, not delay, climate action, economist Stern says
item.description: Highlighting risks of dependence on fossil fuels, Lord Nicholas Stern urges increased green investments, particularly for India, to enhance energy security and achieve net-zero emissions by 2070.

item.title: Elon Musk Net Worth: How SpaceX and Tesla helped Musk become a trillionaire again after market rally
item.description: Elon Musk has returned to trillionaire status after a sharp rise in SpaceX shares, with Tesla also contributing to the rebound. His fortune climbed to about $1.04 trillion, highlighting how closely his wealth remains tied to market movements.

item.title: First Atlantic Hurricane of 2026 Seen Threatening US Gulf Coast
item.description: The US Gulf Coast will likely be hit by the first Atlantic hurricane of the year in coming days by a storm now gathering strength off the Mexican coast.

item.title: 32%, 24%, 52%, 86%: Why these 4 numbers are bad news for Trump before midterms
item.description: The weak approval rating comes at a crucial moment for Republicans, with the 3 November midterm elections set to determine control of both chambers of Congress for the final two years of Donald Trump’s current term.

item.title: Did you receive $90 from Social Security? Who qualifies for Trump’s Medicare rebate and when it will arrive
item.description: Millions of US seniors are receving a one-time $90 Medicare rebate through Social Security deposits. Here's who qualifies, why the payment was sent, when it should arrive, and why about 40 million Medicare enrollees are excluded.&nbsp;

item.title: US House bill honours Indian pilot Smit Machchhar after his brave actions thwarted flydubai terror attack
item.description: The resolution, introduced on October 5, honours Machchhar and the crew and passengers of flydubai Flight 1073, while condemning the attempted attack on the aircraft. The measure has been referred to the House Committee on Foreign Affairs.

item.title: Trump’s ‘take out LA, San Diego’ remark: White House clarifies what he actually meant
item.description: The clarification came after Trump’s Nebraska rally remarks drew criticism from Democrats, a Republican politician and social media users.

item.title: ‘Layoff was a blessing’: Indian woman in Canada says job loss made her rethink life beyond 9-to-5
item.description: Semini Kulathilake recently took to Instagram to reflect on her experience nearly 10 months after losing her job.

item.title: This Indian state, with 112 billionaires and wealth of over ₹63 lakh crore, will impose water cut on its people
item.description: This state will implement water cuts starting 16 October, reducing usage by at least 10% due to drought in 74% of its talukas. Industries are required to recycle 30% of their water.&nbsp;

item.title: ‘Longer but safer’ routes may beat speed: France says IMEC ‘more necessary amid Gaza, Iran, Hormuz crises’
item.description: France’s India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor envoy Gérard Mestrallet said Gaza, Iran tensions and Strait of Hormuz risks have made IMEC more necessary. He said “longer but safer” routes could become preferable, with the corridor evolving into a resilient network of alternative routes.

item.title: Earthquake Today: Tremors felt in Delhi-NCR as 4.9 magnitude quake hit Uttarakhand
item.description: Earthquake tremors were felt in the national capital on Tuesday. So far, there have been no reports of casualties.

item.title: Russia denies anti-plague measures after lab worker’s death: WHO says ‘low’ risk — What we know so far
item.description: A 28-year-old woman, identified by Russian media as Darya Shipilova, reportedly worked at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute of Siberia and the Far East, a facility that studies dangerous pathogens, including plague. She died last week at a hospital in Shelekhov, a town near Irkutsk.

item.title: Could Bolsonaro's election win give Trump his biggest prize yet in Latin America? How big is Brazil's economy? Explained
item.description: Trump has built a Latin America bloc. Could a Bolsonaro win give him his biggest prize yet? How big is Brazil’s economy and resource wealth?

item.title: Jeffrey Archer’s India connection: Why the bestselling author released his new books here before Britain
item.description: Archer described piracy as a major problem in India. He said pirated editions of his latest books could reach the streets before legitimate copies were available in bookshops.
